thread:
Priya: Heads-up — we're scheduling a thermal calibration pass on apac1 GPU racks tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. This is a low-risk maintenance to re-profile fan curves and firmware thermal thresholds. Expect brief node reboots (30–90s) as a step in the process. :thermometer:
Jorge: How are we avoiding a big capacity hit for Dedicated pools? last time we saw 20% throughput dip.
Priya: Plan is staggered cohorts (6-min spacing per node), keep 4 racks pinned as hot reserve for Dedicated traffic, and route lower-priority jobs to spot backfill. No full-pool drains.
Maya: Any network risk? last thermal work touched BMCs and we had a NIC flapping incident.
Priya: We validated the BMC microcode on a canary rack earlier today. NIC firmware won't be touched. We'll run a short preflight: `bmc-healthcheck.sh --quick` on canary then roll.
InfraBot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance/4765432100. Notifying affected teams and setting SLA exemptions for canary buckets.
Caleb: Cost callout — estimated unit-cost bump ~8% for the 2h window because of smaller batching and fewer reuse opportunities. If we push to off-peak we save ~30% of that impact.
Liza: Can we fallback to the quantized model variant for non-critical workloads during the window? That reduces GPU memory churn.
Priya: Yes. We'll update smart-routing policy to prefer `redwood-ggml-q4` for non-SLA routes during the window. Fallback test already passes in staging.
Sam (oncall): Oncall playbook link? who to page if a rack fails to rejoin?
Priya: Playbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/thermal-cal-playbook (see section "rejoin-failure"). Page `infra-oncall` and add `Priya` and `Maya` if auto-retries fail. Expected escalation timeout 10m.
Jorge: Suggestion — run prefix cache pre-warm right after each node comes back: `curl https://warmup.internal/prefix?pool=apac1` . That cut cold-latency last time.
Priya: Good call. We'll add a post-reboot hook to trigger prefix warmers and a lightweight KV priming job.
Caleb: I'll prepare a one-line cost note for Finance: approx $1.6k uplift for the window (estimate). Will post in the maintenance doc.
Maya: Also recommend we throttle large batch jobs for that 2h window — simplest short-term mitigation.
Liza: I'll update job-constraints for noncritical batch queues to `max_batch_size: 16` during the window.
Priya: Final checklist: canary run at 01:30 UTC, cohort spacing 6m, hot reserve 4 racks, model fallback enabled, pre-warm hook, oncall escalation 10m. Posting timeline in the doc now. :thumbsup:
Jorge: ack
Sam (oncall): ack
InfraBot: Reminder sent to users in `#customers-apac` and created incident stub `INC-476543` for tracking.
